_doc: Studio rig shared by the Cycles matcaps (godot/assets/textures/*matcap*.png) and the reference renders (blender/previews/ref_*.png). Directions point TOWARD the light, in Godot VIEW space of the front camera (x right, y up, z toward the camera). Colours are linear RGB (hex = sRGB). 'energy' = Cycles sun strength (W/m2) ; 'relative_energy' = energy / key energy. 'softness_deg' = sun angular diameter (Godot DirectionalLight3D light_angular_distance ~ half of it). Ambient = 3-colour gradient sky (top / horizon / ground), like a Godot ProceduralSkyMaterial; sky_strength multiplies it; seen in REFLECTIONS (glossy rays) the sky is multiplied by sky_specular_factor (dark studio, bright softboxes = the sun discs). Camera is fixed relative to the rig: lights move with the view (matcap convention). Colour management: Standard view transform, exposure as given, no tonemapping.
